The '''Omman Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> located near [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omman Minor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The planet [[Omman]] was created for ''[[When the Domino Falls]]'', which placed it near [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="WtDF">{{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls}}</ref> But after another Omman was placed in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the first was identified as Omman Minor by the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Although it was published later, ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' did not notice this [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
